source: US Treasury daily par yield curve rates

underlying_series.TREASURY_3MO: 3 Month Treasury par yield, daily, averaged within each calendar month
underlying_series.TREASURY_10YR: 10 Year Treasury par yield, daily, averaged within each calendar month
underlying_series.TREASURY_10Y_3M_SPREAD: TREASURY_10YR - TREASURY_3MO, in percentage points -- the Estrella-Mishkin / NY Fed recession-probability model's own spread, not the media-popular '2s10s' framing

resampling: Each calendar month's value is the mean of that month's real daily par yields (the same noise-reduction convention the NY Fed's own published recession-probability model uses for this exact spread), not an end-of-month snapshot.
publication_lag_note: Treasury publishes each business day's par yield curve rates same-day, so a given month's average is honestly knowable by that month's own end -- no forward-fill or lag re-keying needed, unlike kaggle_us_macro_monthly.csv's GDP/claims series.

sanity_checks.TREASURY_10Y_3M_SPREAD 2019-08: -0.3641 (the real, widely-reported August 2019 inversion preceding the Feb 2020 recession)

fetch_method: year-by-year GET against home.treasury.gov's own public CSV download endpoint (type=daily_treasury_yield_curve), no auth, no API key; not committed as project code since it is a one-off fetch, same convention as kaggle_us_macro_monthly.csv's own prep script -- see docs/PR_LEDGER.md for the PR entry describing its exact logic
note_on_earlier_years: home.treasury.gov's CSV endpoint returns no data before 1990 (confirmed by direct request for 1982); this is why this series starts at 1990-01 rather than kaggle_us_macro_monthly.csv's own 1981-12 start.
relationship_to_dat_04: A separate, more general Treasury connector already exists (data_ingestion.treasury_yield_curve, DAT-04/PR-146): a live, multi-tenor fetch via FRED's fredgraph.csv with day-count/holiday conventions recorded. That module's own FRED source was unreachable from this environment both at its original implementation time and independently reconfirmed unreachable here; home.treasury.gov (this file's source) was independently confirmed reachable instead. This file is a narrower, derived feature (one spread, monthly-averaged) for a different, specific use (data_ingestion.treasury_yield_spread, feeding RECESSIONNET), not a replacement for or duplicate of DAT-04's own broader scope.
